replicate_summary_rule: Deduplicate by normalized sequence_id within sequence/context. Preserve all source row IDs and replicate IDs. If a future role uses multiple measured replicates, Evaluator summarizes measured MRL by median within sequence/context, excludes missing values from the median and retains replicate count/missingness. Replicate rows and paired repeats are not independent biological evidence.
q_rule: Uniform over unique feasible sequence_id values within each fixed pool, q=1/N. q is not an independent-evidence weight and does not remove paired-repeat dependence.
selection_rule: Within each role, exclude control IDs/units and all cross-role sequence/near/allocation/trajectory conflicts; aggregate contexts by sequence; sort complete allocation units by unique-sequence count, context count, source-row count, then SHA256(pool_version|role|unit_id); use deterministic exact subset-sum to reach the configured unique-sequence pool size without splitting a unit. No labels or scores are used.
